text:
Alice G: Quick follow-up from today's DR dry-run — captured a few action items and gaps, putting owners/timelines here so we can close before the next game day.

Bob M: high level: warm-standby routing behavior diverged under partial-control-plane loss. traffic went to us-west-2 instead of eu-west-1-warm.

Carol S: noted that the prefix cache priming job failed for several models, added logs below. looks like creds rotated and job lacked fallback.

Dave (SRE): I'm logging runbook gaps: restore-runbook.md step 3 assumes snapshot availability without verifying replication; need explicit check + retry policy.

Priya (Oncall): tagging owners and timelines here: please ack and add ETA. I'll track weekly until closed. :spiral_calendar:

Alice G: ACTION-1: routing policy definition update to prefer warm-standby region on control-plane partial outage. Owner: Bob M. ETA: 2024-05-10. (Depends on test harness).

Bob M: ACK. Will add automated test in routing-sim and schedule canary for 05/08.

Alice G: ACTION-2: priming job should surface credential errors and fallback to requeue + alert. Owner: Carol S. ETA: 2024-04-28.

Carol S: ACK. Patch branch created: fix/priming-cred-retry. I'll include an alert rule in prometheus: priming_job_failures_total > 3 for 5m.

Dave (SRE): ACTION-3: update restore-runbook.md with explicit replication check + retry + timeouts. Owner: Dave (SRE). ETA: 2024-04-25. I'll add a snippet for verifying snapshots:```bash
# verify snapshot exists in destination region
aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:backup,Values=redwood-prod Name=owner-id,Values=123456789012
```

Priya (Oncall): ACTION-4: Add postgame checklist for game days with owner rotation matrix and contact flow. Owner: Alice G. ETA: 2024-04-30. I'll draft the template.

Bob M: Observed recurring pattern: partial-control-plane events coincide with k8s leader flips. Recommend adding runbook section: "If control-plane instability, prefer routing by healthy-az-metrics rather than control-plane."

Alice G: Good call. ACTION-5: add explicit routing fallback rules + unit tests in router. Owner: Bob M. ETA aligned with ACTION-1 (2024-05-10).

Carol S: Also found one off: backup retention policy ambiguity (some snapshots had ttl 7d, others 90d). ACTION-6: inventory backup policies across regions and standardize to 90d for critical state. Owner: Carol S. ETA: 2024-05-03.

Dave (SRE): I'll volunteer to help with automating inventory check. We can run a job:
```python
# pseudo
for region in regions:
    list = aws.snapshots(region).filter(tag='service:redwood')
    report(policy=list.map(s -> s.ttl))
```

Priya (Oncall): Please add the owners as tasks in the DR project board and add links here when done. I'll close weekly check-ins.

Bob M: planning note: will coordinate a small 2-hour game day on 2024-05-12 to validate the routing change + priming fix. seekers invited.

Alice G: Can we also include a short tabletop before the game day? 30 min to run through contacts and playbook. ACTION-7: schedule tabletop + invite: Owner: Alice G. ETA: 2024-05-05.

Carol S: putting PRs into review today for the priming fix and backup inventory script. will post links.

deploy-bot: deploy status: routing-sim v0.3 promoted to staging at 2024-04-20T18:30:12Z :rocket:

Alice G: Thanks all — Priya, can you own weekly closure checks and ping if any ETA slips >4d?

Priya (Oncall): yes — I'll create recurring Slack reminders and update this thread after each check-in.

Dave (SRE): leaving a note: retrospective observation to capture in postmortem: recurring theme is hidden dependencies (backup TTL, credential rotation, test coverage). I'll draft a blameless summary.

Alice G: perfect. I'll consolidate these actions into the postmortem follow-up doc and tag owners. Closing note: try to keep PRs small and include one-line test plan so we can merge earlier. :white_check_mark:

Carol S: links to PRs: https://git.redwood.dev/r/345/priming-fix, https://git.redwood.dev/r/348/backup-inventory

Bob M: routing-sim test plan: https://docs.redwood.dev/internal/routing-sim/DR-tests (will add canary steps).

Alice G: last call — any other blockers?

Bob M: none from me.

Carol S: none.

Priya (Oncall): closing for now, will update weekly. :lock:
